analysis_only.calendar: By exit label in Moscow, include every available calendar month for each instrument and pooled scope; zero months included. R sums are bookkeeping, not real portfolio returns.
analysis_only.concentration: Top 5/10 positive Gross R divided by total positive Gross R, plus removal sensitivity.
analysis_only.drawdown: Closed-trade cumulative R, sorted exit_time/instrument/trade_id with initial equity zero. No capital allocation or mark-to-market portfolio model.
analysis_only.historical_A6_A7: Copy frozen #495 reports as labelled immutable historical benchmarks; never replay or combine.
analysis_only.losing_streak: Consecutive gross_R<0 CLOSED trades in deterministic exit_time/instrument/trade_id order; zero/win resets; also losing-month streak.
analysis_only.loss_changes: All original negative trades: eliminated entries, improved/reversed, unchanged, worsened, terminal; signed matched R changes plus new entries. No outcome input in strategy.
analysis_only.november: Report 2024, November 2024, and 2024 excluding November using the same replay; removal is post-hoc sensitivity only.
analysis_only.trend_categories: At exact original entry identity: fully preserved R >= original R-1e-8; reduced matched R below original; lost entry absent; terminal OPEN unresolved. Also count original >=2R turned nonpositive and reduced below2R.
analysis_only.trend_winner: Original closed gross_R >= 2R; fixed diagnostic definition, never an entry/exit input.
analysis_only.winner_matching: Match version/instrument/direction/exact entry_time. Report skipped, changed, open and retained, and newly introduced entry losses separately. Does not claim causal counterfactual equivalence.

execution.activation: Threshold evaluated only on survived candles. Persistent once activated. A new Stop has no effect on trigger bar, including ambiguous intrabar return through that new Stop.
execution.costs: Zero deducted expenses; Gross R = direction*(exit-entry)/abs(entry-initial_stop). No C1, fee, slippage, or funding calculation.
execution.entry: Original signal Close is a historical oracle, not verified executable Close fill.
execution.h1: Original daily ordinal blocks of four consecutive 15-minute closes. Incomplete or gapped blocks skipped without repacking; state indicators explicitly cross days.
execution.labels: Protective exits retain historical candle Close timestamp, with actual Open/Close endpoints and gap flag; exact intrabar time unknown.
execution.risk: Immutable abs(entry_price-initial_stop), not current Stop distance. SHORT fully mirrored. Threshold equality passes; no floating tolerance for activation.
execution.sequence: Before accessing current favorable extreme for ratchet/activation, check pre-existing Stop at Open and then intrabar adverse extreme. On hit fill adverse Open or Stop, never update threshold/extrema/Stop using that exit candle. Next Close may accept original same-close re-entry.
execution.sessions: No forced flat or reset: original recursive indicators and open position, initial risk, extrema and activation cross sessions/days/years. First next actual observed Open, no synthetic candles.
execution.terminal: No forced liquidation. Terminal OPEN excluded from closed PF/R; report separately and by entry year, not annual snapshots.
execution.trailing: Monotone original continuous-price ratchet with current completed-bar ATR, favorable extreme seeded at entry Close; signal-candle High/Low excluded. Newly proposed Stop may lie beyond current Close; acts next candle and adverse Open honored.

CONTROL.name: ORIGINAL_ATR_TRAILING
CONTROL.rule: Original initial Stop 2 ATR and trailing 3.0 BASELINE / 3.5 OPTIMIZED.

S1.name: TRAIL_AFTER_1R
S1.rule: Hold initial Stop unchanged until favorable extreme on a completed survived post-entry M15 reaches >=1 initial R. Thereafter permit original ATR trailing using all survived favorable extrema since entry. Ratchet active only next observed candle.

S2.name: BREAK_EVEN_1R
S2.rule: Keep original ATR trailing. After completed survived post-entry M15 confirms >=1 initial R, tighten Stop at least to entry. Never loosen. Active only next observed candle.

S3.name: LOCK_1R_AFTER_2R
S3.rule: Keep original ATR trailing. After completed survived post-entry M15 confirms >=2 initial R, tighten Stop at least to entry plus direction*1 initial R. Never loosen. Active only next observed candle.

objective: Gross PF>=2 on meaningful ALL_FOUR full period, separate positive weak-2024 evidence, and review of 2023 R, major winners, frequency and month regularity. No numeric search or respecification after outcomes; report failure honestly.
prohibited: S combinations, A6/A7 combinations, new thresholds, numeric search, Optimization, Robustness, WF, TRUE OOS, LIVE, 2025+ OHLC ingestion or checking, 2024 independent-WF claim.
quality_gates: record reconciliation against #490 and #495: 1442 CLOSED + 2 terminal OPEN
LONG/SHORT causal unit fixtures before outcome computation
independent standard-library raw-prefix features and full replay; all trades, stops, occupancy, terminal states and report rows
two fresh runs, all generated bytes identical
scope: Only new IntradayLab/t3_m15_stop_exit_v1/; immutable original research, ROADMAP, TradingSystemLab, data and production. Draft PR; STOP external review, no merge/auto-merge.
